discussions.name: NWS Seattle
synopsis: A frontal system continues to move east into the Cascades into tonight. A warm front will boost temperatures as it moves northwards Saturday for brief dry conditions. A potent cold front brings rain and gusty winds Saturday night into Sunday. The active pattern continues at times into next week.
hydrology: River flooding is not expected through the next seven days. However, multiple weather systems will bring steadier rainfall at times today, late Saturday into Sunday, and again late Monday into midweek. While current forecasts are not expected to cause flooding, this will begin to saturate soils and raise base flows that could bring a concern with subsequent storms systems, particularly by late next week.

discussions.name: NWS Portland
synopsis: An active weather pattern into next week will produce periods of rain and windy conditions. Saturday afternoon into the overnight hours will see strong winds along the coast and periods of moderate to heavy rainfall. A large westerly swell will bring high surf Sunday and an elevated threat of sneaker waves through the weekend.
